notes: Board of Public Works bookkeeper's tables of bond-issue building contracts for FY1913-14 (vol 63 pp. 322-340), read from the page images because the OCR separates the school, contractor and amount columns. School general-construction contracts and architects only; trades contracts, the hospital finishing work and the Polytechnic academic building (demolished) skipped.

coverage.remaining: Glen Park School (Carnahan & Mulford, $82,424) and Cooper School (C. L. Wold, $80,180, Houghton Sawyer) not placed: the property list puts Glen Park at San Jose and Joost and Cooper on Greenwich between Jones and Leavenworth, neither matching a standing school page with confidence.
